sections.text: Inspection and Repair of All Parts

items:
Check the safety valve cone (4) and regrind 
 the sealing surface of it if needed.

Check the safety valve seat (3) and regrind it 
 if needed. When grinding the seats of the movers, attention must be paid to 
 maintaining the angles of the sealing surfaces. In order to secure the mover 
 function it is not allowed to reduce the seat parts by more than 0.8 mm in 
 total (not more than 0.4 mm for one surface).

Repair the safety valve cone (4) and valve 
 seats (3) in a specialist workshop if grinding can not repair the wear in 
 there.

Check the spindle (7), repair or replace if 
 needed.

Check the spindle nut (16), repair or replace 
 if needed

Check the spring (10), 
 replace if needed.
Clean every part well before any assembly.

Assembly the safety valve parts in reverse 
 sequence of disassembly.

Introduction
This document lists the maintenance 
procedure P1, which must be performed annually base as indicated by Y1 in 
the title block
Safety valve for drum to protect drum from over pressure (up 197.9).
The first draft 
initiated and tested by eng. Fawzy Ahmed Bsiouny, accepted by general director 
pre. eng. 
Saad Mostafa, revised by eng.
Samir Abed El 
Gelil at EDEPC, and approved by eng. Awad Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head Sector 
of Talkha power station.
Technical Specification

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes, etc.
The boiler must be out of operation.
The boiler pressure must be zero.
Isolate the safety valve mechanically and 
electrically.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Suitable lifting device.
Work to be Carried Out
Be sure the pressure in the drum is zero.
Be sure the drum is drained.
Be sure the vents opened
Be sure the temperature inside drum reached to 
 35 C.
Partially Disassembly of Safety Valve
Screw off the nut no. 12
Screw off the nut no. 13
Screw off the nut no. 11
Screw off nuts 11-1
Take up the safety valve.
Inspection and Repair of All Parts
Check the safety valve cone (4) and regrind 
 the sealing surface of it if needed.
Check the safety valve seat (3) and regrind it 
 if needed. When grinding the seats of the movers, attention must be paid to 
 maintaining the angles of the sealing surfaces. In order to secure the mover 
 function it is not allowed to reduce the seat parts by more than 0.8 mm in 
 total (not more than 0.4 mm for one surface).
Repair the safety valve cone (4) and valve 
 seats (3) in a specialist workshop if grinding can not repair the wear in 
 there.
Check the spindle (7), repair or replace if 
 needed.
Check the spindle nut (16), repair or replace 
 if needed
Check the spring (10), 
 replace if needed.
Assembly of Safety Valve
Clean every part well before any assembly.
Assembly the safety valve parts in reverse 
 sequence of disassembly.
If you need 
any help please go to the operating instruction for repairs and maintenance D-4.
After 
successfully assembly coordinate with the shift operation engineer to test the 
valve to check that every thing is OK .
